title: Synthetic Atlas rollback runbook
text: SYNTHETIC ENGINEERING FIXTURE. Atlas rollback procedure, reviewed 2026-10-20: pause new deployments, select the last healthy build, then run atlasctl rollback --revision PREVIOUS. title: Synthetic backup restore procedure
text: SYNTHETIC ENGINEERING FIXTURE. Backup restore procedure: select a verified snapshot, restore into an isolated database, then compare row counts and application checks.
